items.title: Drake London: Leading receiver in Week 9 loss
items.text:
London caught all five of his targets for 68 yards in Sunday's 34-17 loss to the Bengals.

items.title: Bijan Robinson: Big workload in loss to Cincy
items.text:
Robinson carried the ball 19 times for 100 yards and a touchdown and caught six of seven targets for 47 yards in Sunday's 34-17 loss to the Bengals.

items.title: Chase Brown: Quiet in Week 9 win
items.text:
Brown carried the ball nine times for 57 yards and caught all three of his targets for 18 yards in Sunday's 34-17 win over the Falcons.

items.title: Tee Higgins: Finds end zone twice in win over Falcons
items.text:
Higgins caught five of six targets for 32 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 34-17 win over Atlanta.

items.title: Ja'Marr Chase: Dominates in Madrid
items.text:
